relationships.subject: H4
relationships.evidence_quote: H4 potently inhibited hNav1.7 with an IC50 value of 0.007 ± 0.001 μM

relationships.subject: H4
relationships.evidence_quote: H4 dose dependently reduced CFA-induced allodynia

key_findings: Engineered HNTX-III mutant H4 (K0G1-P18K-A21L-V) inhibits hNav1.7 with IC50 0.007 uM and >1000-fold selectivity over Nav1.4, Nav1.5 and Nav1.9.
H4 gave analgesia in acute, inflammatory and SNI neuropathic pain models, comparable or better than morphine.
